result.answer: CoinGecko documentation provides methods for retrieving timestamped historical prices, market caps, and total volumes through `/coins/{id}/market_chart` or `/coins/{id}/market_chart/range`, and global market-cap/volume history through `/global/market_cap_chart`. However, no asset, date range, retrieved observations, or timestamps were supplied or returned in this research pass. Therefore, no source-backed evidence is available to identify recurring 1–3d versus 2–3w conflict structures, or to determine which evidence resolves versus postpones those conflicts. Missingness is preserved.
